anomalies: Ten erroneous native total cells retained beside independently recomputed children/mode totals. Never silently repaired or treated as additional precincts.
contest_comparison: Separate whole-county 2024 President and 2024 House 5 baselines against 2026 House 5. Two-party margin changes are descriptive, not individual persuasion; all literal other parties and write-ins retained.
count_comparison: Signed county report-count changes against the unofficial frozen 2026 observation; not measured prior-voter dropout.
denominator: Native Registered Voters in each report, not VEP, CVAP, fixed people or demographic eligibility.
geography: Native within-election precinct IDs and labels retained; no cross-year identity or analytical geographic overlay.
measure: Native Total Votes Cast, not selected-contest candidate votes.
native_mode_labels: 2020 At Polls/Absentee/Walk-In Absentee retained separately from later E-Election Day/A-Paper Absentee/W-Walk-In Absentee; no unsupported shift attribution.
publication_basis: Selected public government factual counts and functional source identifiers only, with attribution; not a claimed license to redistribute the native documents or site code. No source endorsement.
receipt_headers: All used receipt URLs/status/bytes/hashes/acquisition clocks retained. Only content type/length/disposition/date/last-modified/etag/cache-control headers selected; Set-Cookie, session values and unrelated security headers excluded.
reproduction: Complete selected aggregate inputs, receipts, CSVs, exact standard-library calculator/tests, methods and results. Does not rerun original native PDF/HTML extraction or independently validate outcomes.
selection: Every native precinct and control in all four declared turnout reports; every candidate and precinct in three county-wide contests. No outcome-based unit selection.
source_attribution: Hamilton County, Indiana Election Office; historical and current official election reports.
source_clocks: PDF footer dates, native HTML clocks, HTTP dates and acquisition dates are distinct. 2020 footer year is literally truncated; no missing timezone or year imputed.
